Business Website with 90 Days Free Care

You can get a custom business website with 90 days of free care after launch, and then choose from optional care plans. On this site, you can learn about the different packages available, including the Launch package for $2,950, and get a free homepage remake with no obligations.

How it Works for Your Business

You can choose from different packages, including the Launch package, which includes up to 5 pages, custom design, and SEO basics, all delivered in about a week. The Signature package offers more features, including unlimited sections and galleries, while the Platform package is suitable for web apps and SaaS MVPs. You own your site outright, with $0/month hosting on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.

What You Get and What it Costs

The Launch package costs $2,950, with a 50% deposit and the balance due at launch. The Signature package is $7,500, and the Platform package is $15K. After the initial 90 days of free care, you can choose from care plans at $295/month or $595/month, which you can cancel at any time.

FAQ

What happens after the 90 days of free care? After the initial 90 days, you can choose from optional care plans at $295/month or $595/month, which you can cancel at any time. Do I own my website outright? Yes, you own your site outright, including the code, content, and domain. How long does it take to launch a website? The Launch package typically takes about a week to deliver.

To get started with your custom business website, learn more about the custom website launch package on this site.
